aboutHeading: 40 Years of Handyman Excellence in Melbourne
aboutText: With over 40 years of experience, Trusted Handyman Services in Melbourne has been delivering top-quality workmanship to homes and businesses across the Mornington Peninsula. We specialise in a wide range of services, including painting, plumbing, carpentry, tiling, and complete office fit-outs. Our team prioritises safety, efficiency, and tailored solutions, ensuring every job meets your unique requirements and exceeds expectations.
servicesSubheading: From minor fixes to major projects
servicesText: From minor repairs to major renovations, our skilled and friendly team handles it all. We use modern tools and technology to provide high-quality results with flexible booking options, ensuring a hassle-free experience for every customer.

services.title: Painting & Plastering
services.desc: Professional interior and exterior painting, plastering, and wall repairs for homes and businesses.

services.title: Plumbing & Electrical
services.desc: Expert plumbing fixes, electrical work, and lighting installations to keep your property running smoothly.

services.title: Carpentry & Tiling
services.desc: Skilled carpentry for custom builds and tiling services for floors, walls, and backsplashes.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Renovations
services.desc: Complete renovation services to transform your bathroom or kitchen with modern designs and quality finishes.

services.title: Office Fit-Outs & Project Management
services.desc: Comprehensive office fit-outs, partitions, shelving, and project management for commercial spaces.

services.title: Security & Outdoor Structures
services.desc: Installation of security systems, pergolas, access ladders, and signage for enhanced safety and functionality.
